fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as on Aadhaar. Mahila Shakti Kendra provides skill development, employment, digital literacy, health and nutrition support to rural women.
fields.instruction_hi: Aadhaar ke anusar poora naam likhein. Mahila Shakti Kendra gramin mahilaon ko kaushal vikas, rozgaar, digital saaksharta, swasthya aur poshan sahayata deta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your age. Mahila Shakti Kendra services are available to women of all ages in rural areas for skill training and welfare programs.
fields.instruction_hi: Apni aayu likhein. Mahila Shakti Kendra ki sevaayein gramin kshetron mein sabhi aayu ki mahilaon ke liye kaushal prashikshan aur kalyan karyakramon ke liye uplabdh hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your village and Gram Panchayat name. MSK operates at block level with community college student volunteers providing services door-to-door.
fields.instruction_hi: Apne gaon aur Gram Panchayat ka naam likhein. MSK block level par community college volunteers ke zariye ghar-ghar seva deta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Select the service you need — Skill Training, Digital Literacy, Health Awareness, Legal Aid, or Employment Linkage. MSK coordinates multiple government welfare schemes for women.
fields.instruction_hi: Chahiye seva chunein — Kaushal Prashikshan, Digital Saaksharta, Swasthya Jagrukta, Kanooni Sahayata, ya Rozgaar Linkage. MSK mahilaon ke liye kai sarkari kalyan yojanaaon ka samanvay karta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your mobile number for enrollment confirmation and program schedule updates.
fields.instruction_hi: Enrollment confirmation aur program schedule updates ke liye apna mobile number likhein.
